title: TOOLS-005: Metadata tools copy paths into fixed buffers or pass paths through a shell command unsafely
summary: TOOLS-005: Metadata tools copy paths into fixed buffers or pass paths through a shell command unsafely. `indigo_driver_metadata` uses `strcpy()` from arbitrary CLI arguments into `name[128]`; `indigo_metadata_extractor` builds `clang -E %s` for `popen()` without quoting and then dereferences `pipe` without checking for failure. Long paths can overflow, and specially named driver paths can change shell behavior. Use `snprintf()`/length checks and fork/exec-style invocation or strict shell quoting plus `popen()` failure checks. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
